researchTrial.currentPaperTitle: PatternGSL: A Structured Specification Language for Template-Free and Simulation-Ready 3D Garments
researchTrial.implementation: independent Blender override retaining the validated height-by-angle polar profile while replacing abrupt per-vertex clearance with a four-iteration adjacency-smoothed displacement capped at 12 mm, closing the neckline through a five-ring tapered yoke, reducing the underbody to a seventeen-column 4 mm-sag saddle, limiting sleeve radii to 27-33 mm and replacing the padded hood roll with a compact six-row rear-neck fold; body faces and author code are not copied

releaseBoundary: WORKING until all eight in-scope completion gates pass; Unity, Modular Avatar, NDMF, VRChat and human runtime validation are OUT_OF_SCOPE

clothSimulation.evidence: Fitted shell geometry is authored directly from the target body surface and validated by deterministic clearance and pose checks; no Cloth modifier or point cache is part of this construction.
clothSimulation.reason: The fitted bodysuit is not gravity-settled drapery, so a cloth bake would add cost without representing the authored construction method.
